sheets.title: Four things to draw again, smoother

sugarcube.prompt: A single sugar cube with softly rounded edges: smooth flat faces with a gentle frosted sparkle painted on as tiny white specks. No bumps, no crinkles, no crystals sticking out.
sugarcube.texture: Bright white faces with a faint cool shadow and tiny painted sparkles.

popcorn.prompt: One piece of popcorn made of four or five big smooth rounded puffs clustered together like a little cloud, soft and smooth everywhere, with no sharp edges and no crinkles.
popcorn.texture: Buttery yellow puffs with a warmer golden centre.

cheesewedge.prompt: A wedge of cheese with smooth flat faces and crisp straight edges, four round holes shown as shallow darker dents on the top and sides, not deep cuts.
cheesewedge.texture: Even golden yellow, a slightly deeper yellow rind on the back, darker yellow dents.

bicycle.prompt: A chunky toy bicycle seen from the side, about one and a half times as long as it is tall: two thick wheels made as SOLID discs (dark tyres, grey discs with the spokes painted on as lines, no open gaps anywhere), a thick frame, a brown saddle and a small woven front basket.
bicycle.texture: Dark tyres, grey wheel discs with darker painted spokes, a pomegranate red frame, a brown saddle, a tan woven basket.

note: Fix ups, 10 Oct: the four kinds still drawn as primitives because Meshy could not build them from the earlier pictures (sugar cube, popcorn and cheese came back as crinkled shards or facets; the bicycle's thin wheels came back filled with film). Each line is written against that fault: smooth faces, painted detail, solid wheels. Cut with sheetcut.py --tol 18 --holes 8 (grey things at --tol 10 --holes 0).

doc.blurb: plus one thing for Bazaar Lane: four small things the game needs drawn again, smoother
doc.style: handmade miniatures, rounded and tactile with broad smooth colour areas and a gentle hint of the real material, in warm bright appetising colours, soft even light from the upper left, clean simple shapes. Every surface smooth: no crinkles, bumps, fuzz or thin open gaps; small detail painted on.
